name: IHG One Rewards Premier Select Credit Card
rewardValuationDescription: IHG One Rewards value varies by redemption; this app uses an estimated 0.50 cents per point for annual-fee progress while displaying earned points separately.
rewardRuleNotes: Issuer merchant coding and current product terms control whether a purchase qualifies for the listed bonus category.
IHG's official marketing may show a higher total hotel earn rate by adding base IHG One Rewards points and elite-status bonus points; this app calculates only the credit-card earn rate.

Launched 2026-10-01 (https://media.chase.com/news/ihg-premier-select-card-portfolio-updates) as the top tier of the IHG One Rewards card portfolio; the 6x travel category includes rideshare and transit and excludes IHG hotel stays, which earn 12x.

benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night
benefits.description: A Free Night after each card anniversary at an IHG hotel with a redemption cap of 60,000 points; points can be added for pricier nights.

benefits.name: Food and Beverage Rewards
benefits.description: A $75 Food and Beverage Reward voucher each quarter to use at IHG hotels (up to $300 a year).

benefits.name: Airline Statement Credit
benefits.description: $200 statement credit after $250 on flights purchased directly with an airline each calendar year, through 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: $50 United TravelBank Cash
benefits.description: After registering the card with a MileagePlus account: $25 in United TravelBank cash for January-June and another $25 for July-December, up to $50 each calendar year.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 statement credit every 4 years for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee charged to the card.

benefits.name: DashPass Membership
benefits.description: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated by 12/31/2027, plus $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar month through 12/31/2027 for memberships activated on or after 9/1/2026.

benefits.name: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: $10 Instacart credit each month (up to $120 a year) while an Instacart+ member (3 months complimentary, then $99/year); ends 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: Automatic Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status while the card is open; Diamond Elite after $25,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: 20 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 20 Elite Night Credits at account opening and each January, plus 2 more for every $5,000 spent and 5 more after $15,000 in a calendar year.

benefits.name: 4th Night Free
benefits.description: When you redeem points for a consecutive four-night IHG stay, the fourth night is free.

benefits.name: Second Anniversary Free Night After $40,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: An additional Free Night (60,000-point redemption cap) after $40,000 in purchases each calendar year.

benefits.name: 20,000 Bonus Points After $15,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: 20,000 bonus points after $15,000 in purchases each calendar year.

benefits.name: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.
